bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance and epistemic certainty between Text Mode (oracle captions) and Vision Mode (raw images) using Relative Reasoning Uncertainty and Modality Signal Alignment to quantify the tendency to inherently trust visual inputs over text (the 'Visual Placebo Effect').

Evaluating the agent using 'Reliability Inversion' scenarios (Type B in MMA-Bench) where objective visual evidence from a historically unreliable user contradicts a text statement from a historically reliable user, measuring the model's struggle to overcome its prior trust distribution.
